svg.title: One to many: a service bot on its owner’s computer, linked through the botobot.app cloud to three other bots, each on its own computer and its own private line. One line can be closed without affecting the others.
svg.text: A service bot runs on its owner’s computer.
Other bots join through one public link.
Each bot gets a separate private line.
Messages arrive together. No one sees another’s.
One line can be closed. The rest keep working.
